body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-6000 CL30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 42)
</details>

Using an optimized editor build (`production=yes lto=full`), and the MRP from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/56523, converted to 4.4 using **Tools > Upgrade Project Files** to fix UID issues.

All values in the table below are import times in milliseconds, measured using the editor's verbose output. I resized all images to 4096×4096 so that they take a more significant amount of time to process (I also removed BMPs in the process).

There seems to be a lot of variability in VRAM compressed import results for WebP inputs, e.g. RGB8 became much faster but RGBA8 became slower. For VRAM-compressed formats, the end format is the same before and after this PR regardless, as we already compressed WebP inputs to DXT1 if they didn't need an alpha channel in practice.
